result.title: Orthogonally Mixed Sign Coding with Progressive Residual Refinement for Transformer Weight Compression
result.summary: LLM quantization reduces storage but often degrades predictive fidelity at low bit rates. We propose a training-free, CDF-free, Gaussian-CLT-motivated progressive residual-sign quantization framework that uses randomized orthogonal mixing to promote Gaussian-like residual distributions and improve sign based reconstruction of Transformer weights. Each stage independently normalizes residuals and analytically calibrates reconstruction, progressively recovering quantization errors. The framework enables flexible storage-fidelity trade-offs without learned codebooks, empirical CDFs, or trellis optimization. We evaluate GPT-2 Large and Llama-3-8B across attention and MLP projections. At five residual stages, joint quantization preserves near-baseline predictive fidelity, achieving perplexities of 32.16 and 12.73, compared with full-precision values of 29.89 and 11.07, respectively. Ablations further demonstrate that orthogonal mixing substantially improves reconstruction over identity-based sign coding, while activation-aware scaling improves output fidelity and reduced-precision statistics lower storage overhead with negligible perplexity degradation. Comparisons with conventional quantizers establish the method's progressive fidelity recovery and characterize its storage-quality and runtime trade-offs. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of orthogonally mixed residual-sign coding for flexible, training-free Transformer weight compression.

AI.brief_summary: 该工作提出免训练、免 CDF 的渐进残差符号量化框架，用随机正交混合使 Transformer 权重残差更接近高斯分布，从而逐阶段恢复量化误差，在 GPT-2 Large 与 Llama-3-8B 上换取存储与保真度的折中。
AI.relevance_reason: 论文只针对静态权重压缩与困惑度保真，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的 latent 状态生成、证据使用、动态计算或停止决策，也未提供可迁移到推理期表示的方法线索，与 LVR 研究主线缺少实质联系。
